content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Traditional platforms impose fees that can significantly cut into your profits. For instance, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, while NOWPayments only takes 0.5%. By adopting a sovereign commerce stack, you avoid reliance on these platforms and their fees, allowing for greater revenue retention. The infrastructure is designed to function independently of conventional payment processors, giving you the freedom to operate without restrictions and ensuring that your earnings remain intact.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, ensure you have the necessary tools and accounts ready. You will need a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting, a NOWPayments account for processing Bitcoin, and a method for automatic product delivery, such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Additionally, familiarize yourself with using Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. Having these components set up prior to deployment is essential for a smooth transition.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, start by integrating NOWPayments into your infrastructure. This step allows you to accept Bitcoin seamlessly. Next, configure Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate product delivery once payment is confirmed. Ensure your order storage solution is correctly linked to track sales and manage product access. This workflow enables you to deliver ebooks immediately upon purchase, enhancing customer satisfaction and streamlining operations.
Keep 99.5% of your earnings with minimal fees using NOWPayments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it's time to go live. Test your payment processing by conducting a trial transaction with your own wallet. Ensure that the product delivery is automated and occurs instantaneously upon payment confirmation. Monitor the transaction flow to address any issues promptly. With a fully operational stack, you are now positioned to accept Bitcoin for ebook sales without the involvement of traditional platforms.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After establishing your sales pipeline, focus on scaling your operations. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to expand your offerings and refine your processes. This kit includes multiple blueprints and templates to help you optimize your stack. As your sales grow, consider automating more aspects of your business to free up time for product creation. Continuous improvement of your infrastructure will allow you to adapt and thrive in the digital marketplace.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Automate delivery to enhance customer satisfaction and streamline sales.

If you're looking to sell ebooks, templates, or other digital products without the constraints of platforms like Gumroad or Payhip, consider our Complete Builder Kit ($197). It provides everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more details.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I accept Bitcoin for my ebook sales?
To accept Bitcoin, integrate NOWPayments into your digital commerce stack. This will allow you to process payments directly without relying on traditional payment platforms.
What are the costs involved in using this infrastructure?
NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee per transaction, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%. This cost-effectiveness enhances your profit margin.
How do I automate product delivery after purchase?
Utilize Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate the delivery of ebooks once payment is confirmed. This ensures customers receive their products immediately.
Can I sell other digital products using this setup?
Yes, this infrastructure is versatile and can be used to sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, and more, allowing you to diversify your digital product offerings.
What happens after I deploy my stack?
After deployment, monitor your transactions and product deliveries. Use the Complete Builder Kit to refine and scale your operations based on sales performance.
